voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Juanito (u1CVBnSUn9JiL8ssgd2v), Taglish, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.32 s, atempo 1.0

lines.text: Palayo ang mga bakas. Pero papalapit ito.
lines.beat_before: hook: low along the trail of prints, all pointing away; far down the trail, two eyes between two legs, coming closer

lines.text: Sa Visayas at Mindanao, may kuwento ng sigbin. Naglalakad daw ito nang paatras, nakayuko ang ulo sa pagitan ng mga hulihang paa.
lines.beat_before: the farm at night: the goats all standing, turned toward the field

lines.text: Parang kambing na walang sungay. Malalaki ang tainga. At mabaho.
lines.beat_before: the pen: the goats crowd a corner; there were four; the gate swings open; prints leading out

lines.text: Sa gabi raw ito lumalabas, para uminom ng dugo.
lines.beat_before: the dog: it whimpers and backs into its kennel, eyes on the dark

lines.text: Kaya kapag may nakita kang bakas na palayo sa bahay mo,
lines.beat_before: the farmer with his lamp follows the prints out into the field, away from the house
behind him, toward the house: it backs up the trail, stepping into its own prints, ears dragging
inside: the child asleep, the lamp; at the window, its back rises; the lamp gutters
the farmer turns; his lamp follows the prints back to the house, to the window; then its face, upside down, looks up at us
